title: Personal Loans Refinance Loans: Sizing When the Loan Being Refinanced Was Itself a Refinance
content:
## Rule

The sizing form of a Personal Loans refinance application follows whether the loan being refinanced was itself funded as a Larkspur refinance loan and how many whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the application date it was funded:

- a loan itself funded as a refinance fewer than 12 whole months before is not charged an origination fee again on money that only retires it, so the amount financed is the payoff to be covered;
- a loan itself funded as a refinance 12 to 23 whole months before is charged the fee on the payoff to be covered only, added on top rather than withheld, so the amount financed is the payoff to be covered times one plus the refinance fee percent over 100;
- any other loan is not affected by this rule.

The resulting amount is rounded to the cent and then rounded up to a whole dollar, an amount already in whole dollars being kept as it is. A loan funded as a refinance is one whose loan purpose is the refinance of an existing Larkspur loan; its funding date is on the loan's record.

## Decision table

| Loan being refinanced | Whole months from its funding to the application date | Amount financed |
|---|---|---|
| funded as a refinance | fewer than 12 | the payoff to be covered |
| funded as a refinance | 12 to 23 | the payoff to be covered times one plus the refinance fee percent over 100 |
| funded as a refinance | 24 or more | not affected by this rule |
| funded for any other purpose | any | not affected by this rule |

## Cases (hypothetical, payoff to be covered 10000.00, refinance fee percent 2.99)

- Funded as a refinance on 14 March, application on 13 March of the next year: 11 whole months, amount financed 10000.00.
- Funded as a refinance on 14 March, application on 14 March of the next year: 12 whole months, 10000.00 times 1.0299 is 10299.00, amount financed 10299.00.
- Funded as a refinance on 14 March, application on 13 March two years later: 23 whole months, amount financed 10299.00.
